detail.title: AI Dependence and Reduced Autonomy in Athletes
detail.summary: AI-generated training recommendations are positively associated with a tendency to outsource body signal interpretation, which subsequently links to a reduced sense of self-regulation in athletes.
detail.reason: The source material provides a structural equation model linking AI dependency to reduced self-regulation, directly supporting the project's question.
